query: Which material can be used for lightweight and superior comprehensive performance, and why?

generation.hypothesis: High-entropy alloys (HEAs) can be used for lightweight and superior comprehensive performance due to their unique properties, such as high strength, hardness, and thermal stability.
generation.intervention: Introduction of refractory elements (Ti, Zr, Hf, V, Nb, Ta, Cr, Mo, W) into the alloy composition
generation.conditions: Elevated temperatures, high thermal stability, and softening resistance
generation.mechanism: Dispersion strengthening effect and second-phase strengthening effect
generation.predicted_outcome: Improved strength, hardness, and thermal stability
generation.boundary: Limited by the formation of brittle intermetallic compounds
generation.uncertainty: The optimal composition and processing conditions for HEAs are still being researched and require further investigation

falsification_experiment.design: Comparison of mechanical properties between HEAs and conventional alloys
falsification_experiment.falsification_rule: If the HEAs do not exhibit superior mechanical properties compared to conventional alloys, the hypothesis is falsified
